topics.name: AI 2027 Scenario Forecast
topics.summary: A deeply researched interactive scenario forecast by Scott Alexander, Daniel Kokotajlo and a team of super forecasters predicting month-by-month AI progress. Features two endings: a race scenario ending in AI bioweapon release, and a slowdown scenario with aligned superintelligence. Lead author's P-Doom is ~70%. Accessible as interactive dashboard at ai-2027.com.

topics.name: Trump Tariffs and Market Impact
topics.summary: Stock market lost $2 trillion on the day (framed as 1.42x 9/11 economic impact); Morgan Housel argued volatility is a permanent feature of capitalism and markets process information faster in the internet age; TinyCorp faces negative margins from tariffs on GPU imports with no domestic alternative.

topics.name: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
topics.summary: Anthropic protocol solving the M×N integration combinatorial problem for AI agents; created by two London-office Anthropic engineers; the entire industry from GitHub to Google is adopting it; Shawn Wang argues it enables much faster agent capability deployment but doesn't solve the problem of what to build with agents.

topics.name: Honey Affiliate Cookie Fraud Allegations
topics.summary: Ryan Hudson disputed a 17M+ view YouTube video alleging Honey systematically hijacked affiliate cookies from creators; argued stand-down policies at affiliate networks prevent override of upstream creator links and showed the video's screenshots contradicted its own claims; class action lawsuits have been filed against PayPal.

topics.name: AI Agent Capability Trajectories
topics.summary: METR study shows the AI agent 50th-percentile human capability horizon is doubling every 3-7 months and is currently at approximately one hour of autonomous operation; this implies predictable scaling milestones for one-day, one-week, and one-year autonomous agents.

topics.name: Consumer Health and Wellness Market
topics.summary: Kirsten Green presented: 60% of consumers rank health as #1 priority; wellness economy is $1.8T growing 6x faster than GDP; proactive health spending on supplements, biomarker testing, and MRIs is surging; AI-enabled personalization seen as transformative for the space.

topics.name: AI Impact on Writing and Creativity
topics.summary: David Perell argued utilitarian writing will be fully automated, making writing an art form focused on vibe and authenticity; managerial-class workers adopted AI faster than frontline workers because LLM interaction mirrors delegation; McLuhan's acceleration theory predicts a Renaissance in writing quality analogous to perspective in Renaissance painting.

topics.name: Market Volatility and Investor Psychology
topics.summary: Morgan Housel argued volatility has characterized markets for 200+ years, periods of apparent smooth sailing were precursors to crashes, and the internet makes crises faster and shorter rather than more frequent; recommends investors match strategy to personality rather than fight instincts.

topics.name: Intel/TSMC Chip Making JV
topics.summary: Intel and TSMC tentatively agreed to a joint venture; Intel executives worried about mass layoffs; seen as unexpected out-of-the-box thinking by Intel's new leadership rather than the commonly predicted company split.

topics.name: Tech Industry's Religious Shift
topics.summary: David Perell described a trend of tech founders and investors turning toward Christianity, driven by disillusionment with institutional credibility loss, the philosophical bankruptcy of atheism as a moral foundation, and study of thinkers like Renee Girard and Peter Thiel.

topics.name: Browser Extension Business Models
topics.summary: Ryan Hudson explained that Google's Chrome Store single-purpose policy has effectively killed most browser extension monetization opportunities; Honey succeeded by combining affiliate with cashback before this tightened; outside of crypto wallets and shopping tools almost no large browser extension businesses exist.

topics.name: Venture Capital Trends 2025
topics.summary: AngelList data shows capital flows to venture funds nearly doubled Q1 2024 to Q1 2025, but concentrating in select managers; early-stage valuations rising due to supply-demand mismatch as AI-era startups require less capital; crossover public-market firms mostly exited venture.

topics.name: AI-First Healthcare Model
topics.summary: Sword Health's V argued AI must shift healthcare from 100% labor-intensive model to AI-first to break the cost-quality paradox; current system spends $560B/year on physical pain mostly on preventable surgeries; AI can provide access at scale currently impossible with human clinicians alone.

topics.name: Andurril Seabed Sentry Launch
topics.summary: Andurril launched an AI-enabled undersea sensor node network in partnership with 50-year-old Sonerdyne for persistent subsea monitoring; addresses vulnerability of undersea cables and can detect submarines, vessels, and marine life.

topics.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro Pareto Dominance
topics.summary: Shawn Wang's viral tweet of the day: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro simultaneously dominates the entire Pareto frontier of all AI labs being both the most capable and most cost-efficient model.

topics.name: Rippling/Deal Corporate Espionage
topics.summary: Deal allegedly planted a spy inside Rippling; Polymarket launched a market showing 71% probability the Deal CEO departs in April 2025; Deal has not publicly responded to allegations.

topics.name: Hershey Acquisitions Healthy Portfolio Strategy
topics.summary: Hershey acquired Lesser Evil (organic popcorn) for $750M and Sour Strips as part of a deliberate healthy halo portfolio strategy to hedge against cocoa price volatility and capture wellness consumer spend.

topics.name: Inference-to-Impact and Inference Risk Quotient Frameworks
topics.summary: 'Carried No Interest' coined I2I (inference-to-impact) measuring time from LLM call to customer utility and IRQ (inference risk quotient) measuring risk from LLM errors; Cursor scores well on both; AI SDRs score poorly on I2I; Harvey scores high IRQ due to legal liability exposure.
